name: Ahmed
greetingText: The mastermind behind pranks that left us laughing, confused, and occasionally questioning reality.
wishText: Ahmed, may your birthday be as legendary as your pranks—full of surprises, laughter, and just the right amount of chaos!
textInChatBox: Happy Birthday, Ahmed! May your day be filled with laughter, mischief, and memories worth pranking about.
text2: We were going to just say 'Happy Birthday.'
text3: But then we thought, that's too predictable.
text4: So we decided to make it
text5Content: You're the king of unforgettable moments.
outroText: Alright, now go pull off a birthday prank and make it epic.
replayText: Or click here if you want to relive the fun.
